Synopsis: Shadowheart appears at the player's campsite one night after they missed all other opportunites to recruit her in their party. She seems unhinged, paranoid - convinced that we intend to steal something important that she possesses. We may learn that the item she refers to is the mysterious cube - a sentient gith artefact that's manipulating her into appearing to us and forcing a confrontation. The cube contains the long-imprisoned spirit of a gith general, who wants to fall into our party's hands in an effort to eventually break free. He's forcing Shadowheart to either join the party or get killed by the party - either way, the cube will be where it wants to be. Cluster Contexts: - CAMP_Shadowheart_CFM_Ultimatum.json: Shadowheart is a Shar-worshipping survivor of the Nautiloid crash who the player failed to recruit earlier and who has been moving between off‑screen locations (beach, chapel, druid grove, goblin camp) before turning up at the player's campsite. She is sleep‑deprived, paranoid and hearing incessant whispering that pushes her toward the player; those voices are coming from a mysterious, sentient gith cube she carries. The cube contains the long‑imprisoned spirit of a gith general that is manipulating Shadowheart into bringing the artefact to — or into conflict with — the party so it can fall into their hands. Off‑screen history (her secret mission for Shar, prior encounters or abandonment during the crash, and hostility toward gith) explains her guarded, knife‑ready stance and why she may be volatile or accusatory. The scene may also present an intrusive "mind‑meld" narration if the player hasn't yet experienced similar companion mental intrusions. - ShadowHeart_Recruitment_Den.json: The player encounters Shadowheart sheltering in the Druid Grove. When we find her, she seems greatly preoccupied with a strange githyanki artefact. She may join our party after we speak to her, but needs more convincing in the case that gith are present. Note: Much of this scene plays out in a similar manner to Shadowheart's previous recruitment opportunity closer to the site of the nautiloid crash - we can find her at the druid grove if we advance forwards without recruiting her - she makes her own way to the grove off screen. We may have met her previously, in which case she's suspicious as to why we keep bumping into one another. We may even have been forced to abandon her during our earlier escape from the ship - something she'll recall bitterly. Shadowheart is particularly reluctant to deal with gith players - they were her enemies during her prior secret mission to steal the strange artefact, though the player will not know this yet - Shadowheart_Recruitment_Camp.json: A follow-up with Shadowheart after her Ultimatum dialogue, where the Box forces her to camp in a haze of murderous madness. Occurs if the player talked her down and got her to rest. She's calmer now, but still unsettled and confused - what is it that compelled her to act against her will like that? She and the player can discuss, but no clear answer emerges. The player can invite her to join their party. - ShadowHeart_Recruitment_Gob.json: After Shadowheart arrives at Goblin Camp with the Orpheus box and protects the party from Voice of the Absolute, she asks to be recruited. She is desperate at this point, so either this happens or she will start combat.NOTE: this currently only triggers at the goblin camp, but may also be needed as a fallback at the start of Act 2. - ShadowHeart_Recruitment.json: General Note: Shadowheart is a potential avatar or companion. She is a worshipper of the dark goddess Shar, sent on a secret mission, the purpose of which is pivotal to the overall plot. The full truth of what she's up to will only be revealed over time. Situation Summary: The same as the player, Shadowheart has just survived the Nautiloid crash. Prior to this, she was also kidnapped by the mind flayers and tadpoled. Now the player encounters her a short distance from the crash wreckage, trying to break down an ancient door set in the bottom of a cliff face. Around her are several dead intellect devourers - she's had to defend herself since the crash. Becoming aware of the player, she recognises a fellow survivor, and the fact that they too are tadpoled. She explains that she's trying to get through the door in search of supplies or shelter. The player has a chance to suggest they team up and try to survive. She's cagey about other matters when asked - she seems unwilling or unable to go into her background in any great detail. If the player encountered her during the tutorial section, she'll react to this (including whether they tried to help her or not). If the player is githyanki, she'll be more aggressive and difficult to win over.JLatino: It's important to remember that SH is tired, exhausted and along. She just survived the crash of an alien vessel on which she was held prisoner. She's sizing the player up as a threat, while knowing she doesn't have a lot in the tank to fight back if it comes to it. The player encounters Shadowheart sheltering in the Druid Grove. When we find her, she seems greatly preoccupied with a strange githyanki artefact. She may join our party after we speak to her, but needs more convincing in the case that gith are present.
Note: Much of this scene plays out in a similar manner to Shadowheart's previous recruitment opportunity closer to the site of the nautiloid crash - we can find her at the druid grove if we advance forwards without recruiting her - she makes her own way to the grove off screen. We may have met her previously, in which case she's suspicious as to why we keep bumping into one another. We may even have been forced to abandon her during our earlier escape from the ship - something she'll recall bitterly. Shadowheart is particularly reluctant to deal with gith players - they were her enemies during her prior secret mission to steal the strange artefact, though the player will not know this yet

A follow-up with Shadowheart after her Ultimatum dialogue, where the Box forces her to camp in a haze of murderous madness. Occurs if the player talked her down and got her to rest. She's calmer now, but still unsettled and confused - what is it that compelled her to act against her will like that? She and the player can discuss, but no clear answer emerges. The player can invite her to join their party.

After Shadowheart arrives at Goblin Camp with the Orpheus box and protects the party from Voice of the Absolute, she asks to be recruited. She is desperate at this point, so either this happens or she will start combat.NOTE: this currently only triggers at the goblin camp, but may also be needed as a fallback at the start of Act 2.

General Note: Shadowheart is a potential avatar or companion. She is a worshipper of the dark goddess Shar, sent on a secret mission, the purpose of which is pivotal to the overall plot. The full truth of what she's up to will only be revealed over time.

context: Shadowheart is a Shar-worshipping survivor of the Nautiloid crash whom the player failed to recruit earlier; she has been moving between off‑screen locations (beach, chapel, druid grove, goblin camp) before turning up at the player’s campsite. She’s sleep‑deprived, paranoid and hearing incessant whispering coming from a mysterious sentient gith cube she carries — the cube contains the imprisoned spirit of a gith general that is manipulating her to bring the artefact to the party (or force a confrontation so it can fall into their hands). Her secret mission for Shar, prior encounters during the crash and hostility toward gith explain why she’s guarded, volatile and knife‑ready. If the player hasn’t yet experienced companion mind‑melds, the scene may include a sudden intrusive narration that reflects her fractured, forced state.
